data.name: Workshop Works
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Workshop Works, the works of the workshop :P 

I have been building my whole life and its time i brought my skills to the digital world to help captivate imaginations across the world. My builder is intended to help people create their dream whether its quitting your job and starting a food truck or building a Boondocking sleeper van and committing to a van life, i have done it all.

You can use the cost fields to enter in the cost of your part you are adding so you can have a rough idea on parts and materials. I can give you an estimate on building your unit if your interested. If not feel free to use the game to help you plan out your build and do it yourself! 

I'm working on several new features that will assist in planning such as the fbx export and the layout screenshot with total cost.

I've added in a custom part spawner and you can set the dimensions of your custom part as well as the price. this will be useful for making custom wood panels or representations of parts i don't have yet.

🔹 Features:

🛠️ Modular Building System – Build your dream Food Truck, Conversion van, or Trailer!
🖌️ Customization – Resize, recolor, and tweak objects to fit your vision perfectly.
🔄 Undo & Redo System – Easily correct mistakes or experiment with different layouts.
💰 Real-time Price Calculation – Track material costs as you build.
🎵 Built-in Radio – Tune in to curated stations while you work.
📸 Save & Share – Capture screenshots or export designs for future use.

Whether you're a hobbyist, designer, or dreamer, Workshop Works gives you the tools to bring your ideas to life in an interactive 3D space. Get ready to build your masterpiece!
